1. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material on a threaded region of an opening in a multi-piece assembly, wherein the first coating material is applied __solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads__; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of the opening to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the multi-piece assembly; and tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface, __wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive applied by inserting at least one plunger into the opening and rotating the plunger within the opening__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __verifying that__ the first coating material __is__ applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising adjusting the first friction interface independent of the second friction interface __by controlling the amount and application method of the first coating material during the applying step__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3, wherein adjusting the first friction interface includes adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region __during application by the plunger rotation__, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface without affecting friction at the second friction interface.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein applying the first coating material includes __spraying a coating fluid into the opening to partially fill__ the opening __while rotating the plunger__.

9. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing a second coating material at the second friction interface.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive.

12. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material on a threaded region of an opening in a first multi-piece assembly included in plurality of multi-piece assemblies, wherein the first coating material is applied __solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads__; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to [[the aperture]] __the opening__ to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the first multi-piece assembly, the fastener having a second coating material; tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface; __wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive applied by inserting at least one plunger into the opening and rotating the plunger within the opening; and__ adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region in a subsequent multi-piece assembly __during application by the plunger rotation__, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface of the subsequent multi-piece assembly compared with the first multi-piece assembly, the friction at the second friction interfaces of the first multi-piece assembly and the subsequent multi-piece assembly being substantially equal.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising: establishing the multi-piece assemblies as connecting rods; wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive __applied by inserting at least one plunger into the opening and rotating the plunger within the opening__ and the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising __verifying that__ the first coating material __is__ applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, wherein applying the first coating material includes __spraying a coating fluid into the opening to partially fill__ the opening __while rotating the plunger__.
